summary: Nano-X Imaging filed a Form 6-K furnishing a business update and preliminary unaudited Q3 2026 results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, via press release dated October 16, 2026. Disclosures include a Nanox.AI distribution agreement with Technologic s.r.l. (an affiliate of Tecnologie Avanzate) to commercialize the Bone Solution in Italy, and TIME Best Inventions 2026 recognition for Nanox.ARC X. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. The release is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf; a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
